cs.t: I've been using an 8k 65" TV as a monitor for four years now.  When I bought it, you could buy the Samsung QN700B 55" 8k, but at the time it was 50% more than the 65" I bought (TCL). I wish the 55" 8k TVs still existed (or that the announced 55" 8k monitors were ever shipped).  I make do with 65", but it's just a tad too large.  I would never switch back to 4k, however.
